notes.title: LIVE NOW - God of Portals and Transitions Update
notes.content: [p]The OB16 Update warps into SMITE 2 with style as Janus makes his grand return! This portal-popping powerhouse brings his iconic playstyle with powerful changes to his kit. He now stacks his passive twice, ignores magical protections to enemies Phased by Threshold, and his global ult can be fired mid-banish while falling from his Portal to set up some hype plays! Whether you're banishing foes or zipping through space-time, Janus is back and ready to transition his team to a win![/p][p]New Ported God[/p][list][*][p][b]Janus[/b][/p][list][*][p]General[/p][list][*][p]Ranged Basic Attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Type: Magical[/p][/*][*][p]Scaling Type: Intelligence Scaling[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Passive: Passages[/p][list][*][p]When you pass through a Portal or Threshold, your next ability deals bonus Magical Damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smite 2 +1’s[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now stacks up to 2 times.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ability 1: Portal[/p][list][*][p]Open a portal on a surface.[/p][list][*][p]Wall portals create a passage to the other side for yourself[/p][/*][*][p]Ground portals Banishes you and enemies upwards, dealing Magical Damage to enemies on landing[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ability 2: Unstable Vortex[/p][list][*][p]Launch two linked portals, dealing Magical Damage to enemies in their path.[/p][list][*][p]Hitting an enemy with both portals deals bonus Magical Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ability 3: Threshold[/p][list][*][p]Unleash a rift that Slows enemies and grants Movement Speed to allies who cross it.[/p][list][*][p]Slowed enemies are Phased, causing your abilities to deal bonus Magical Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Passive: You and allies also gain stacking Movement Speed when crossing the rift or passing through a portal[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Smite 2 +1’s[/b][/p][list][*][p] Magical Damage Janus deals to Phased enemies ignore 25% of their Magical Protection[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ultimate Added the Highlights feature.

Plus, get ready for his "Aspect of Transformation" coming July 18, which amps up his animal forms adding unique effects to his other abilities.[/p][p]The Wandering Market’s got two new spicy additions headed your way. From smashing foes with his Magic Cudgel to pulling stealthy tricks with his Somersault Cloud, Wukong’s hybrid-scaling kit makes him a formidable brawler with a mystical flair.

Some aspects of Quick Play will evolve over time as we work to find what works best for players, and some things introduced in Quick Play may eventually graduate into other modes.    [/p][/*][*][p]        Initially, Quick Play Arena includes the following:        [list][*][p]                [b]Roguelike Item Building[/b]                [list][*][p]                        Players are presented with a choice between three general playstyles at the start of each match                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Then, each time they return to base with enough gold to purchase T3s, they are presented with a choice between three T3s that fit with that playstyle                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Note: Players cannot access the Item Shop as they do in a traditional game of SMITE. They also cannot purchase T1 or T2 items.                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        This is intended to show the fun of building in a more accessible format, helping newer players to start having fun more quickly                    [/p][/*][/list]            [/p][/*][*][p]                [b]Dodge Button[/b]                [list][*][p]                        Players may make a quick dodge by pressing Shift on PC, or their Cancel button on Console (while a targeter is not up)                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Melee Gods dodge farther than ranged Gods                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        A short movement speed buff is applied following a Dodge                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Note: Players do not have Immunity while Dodging; this is a test of allowing more action and repositioning during fights, in a way that should be easy for players to read                    [/p][/*][/list]            [/p][/*][*][p]                [b]Faster Projectiles[/b]                [list][*][p]                        Ranged basic attack projectiles will travel slightly faster in this mode                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        This is roughly equivalent to the projectile speed increase granted by Griffonwing Earrings in SMITE 1                    [/p][/*][/list]            [/p][/*][*][p]                [b]Faster Pacing[/b]                [list][*][p]                        Changes to Gold, XP, and Tickets should lead to approximately 10 minute matches                    [/p][/*][/list]            [/p][/*][*][p]                [b]Action Cam 2.0[/b]                [list][*][p]                        A new, alternate camera position and aiming style which should feel much more familiar to fans of third-person shooters                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        In this camera perspective, your crosshairs are locked to the center of your screen; you will always shoot your basic attacks and abilities where you are looking                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        This does allow Ranged gods to shoot their basic attacks up or down; allowing this was needed for this camera style to feel natural. Note that Gods are still invulnerable during Leaps, even when using Action Cam 2.0.                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Our internal testing shows that players more familiar with third-person shooters are more successful at hitting basic attacks with this style of camera, despite being able to theoretically miss shots by aiming too high or too low.                    [/p][/*][*][p]                        Note: Though we are listing this alongside the other Quick Play experiments, the new Action Cam can be used in any mode                    [/p][/*][/list]            [/p][/*][/list]    [/p][/*][*][p]        Currently, there is only a Quick Play Arena queue. notes.title: LIVE NOW - God of Success Update
notes.content:
[p]
    Brace yourselves Deities, because Ganesha is charging onto the Battleground! This benevolent powerhouse brings blessings to allies and devastation to enemies with magical crowd control, protective auras, and his mighty Dharmic Pillars. Plus, his Aspect of the Triumphant is dropping June 20 for those looking to dish out some divine damage!

    The Wandering Market welcomes two new themed Travelers: the patriotic Freedom Traveler featuring Ra’Merica and Thorge Washington, and the magical Guan Unicorn Traveler including new whimsical Prisms for this fan favorite Classic Skin. Graphical settings will automatically adjust for new PC players based on their system performance
Players will now auto-bypass the login screen if the servers are active; we saved you a click every time you log in!
Players’ last-played queue will now be remembered in online settings. If you last played Joust on PC and then go to play on Xbox, Joust should be the selected queue.
Added a button to Close the Settings menu
Several Match Lobby clean-ups have been made for better clarity:
Activate Boost is only visible in Assault
Change Role is only visible in Conquest
Role Tabs are only visible in Conquest
Owned Gods are always sorted to the top of the list
Added a button to close the filter tab
Aspects are disabled until a player reaches Account Level 5

Aspects are generally slightly more complicated or slightly more niche than a God’s core kit. We want to make sure players are a little more comfortable with SMITE before introducing the idea of Aspects.
Players will automatically Autobuild (including a Relic selection) until reaching Account Level 5
Similarly, forcing new players to click through selecting an Autobuild (or accidentally turning on Manual Build) and Relic was unnecessary complexity at this point in their learning journey.
Relic descriptions on the pre-game Relic Selection Screen have been simplified
This text is intended to help players quickly understand and decide which Relic to purchase. The full text is still available via tooltips.
Help Text should now be more obvious
The old color treatment was very easy for new players to miss
New Players will default to a new “Action Camera” perspective
We believe that new players will be better served by a camera with a narrower FOV, which makes targets in front of them appear bigger and allows combat to be easier to read
This should not affect current players, who may prefer the wider FOV currently used, which allows you to see more happening off to the sides at the expense of making things in front of you smaller
This is just the first test of this camera, and further changes may occur
If you want to change your camera setting, go to Settings > Gameplay and find Action Camera at the bottom of the list
Added “Good for New Players” tags to the Free Rotation Gods
Number Summing
If a single ability deals multiple instances of damage, those damage numbers will now add together
For example: If Anubis 1 deals 30 damage per tick, it will show 30, then 60, then 90 instead of showing 30 three times
This can be disabled in Settings
Directional Damage Indicators
A red arrow will appear on the HUD and point towards Gods when they damage you
The size of this arrow is scaled to the damage dealt, and will increase in size as you are dealt additional damage
This can be disabled in Settings

tags.feature: - Scylla makes her terrifying debut with her iconic monstrous ultimate that lets you chain kills like a pro.
- Alongside her arrival, the Spellbound Realms Wandering Market drops with four pages of enchanting rewards.
- Grab Arcane Ape Hun Batz, Magic Mischief Merlin, Sir Croakus Bacchus, and loads of fantasy themed cosmetics.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

tags.bug: - Fixed an empty item panel sometimes showing on the scoreboard.
-DE_Library: Fixed bug where some clients would crash on bomb explosion.
- Fixed a bug where removing/adding a silencer would also drop a magazine on the ground.

tags.balance_change: * Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Bonus movement speed reduced from +40 to +30

tags.feature: - Added the Highlights feature.
- A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.

tags.bug: - Totem Buff VFX now placed on ground around Phoenix instead of hovering above
- Made adjustments to his Basic Attack timing and sounds to better line up with his hit.
- Brawlers Ruin now correctly only provides the buff on your god Kills and Assists

tags.balance_change: - You only gain Fuel from Pyroclast and when damaged by enemies instead of over time. Magma Rush can no longer be refired but now provides Healing. Additionally Everlasting Flame now provides Protections instead of Strength and Lifesteal, and Volcanic Lightning damage no longer has Strength Scaling.

- Hysteria applied over max deals damage. Max Hysteria no longer reduces damage. Consign Spirits only heals Baron. Vivid Gaze bonus now grants Hysteria over time, but no debuff. Wrap It Up explosion and DoT apply Bonus Hysteria, but the explosion no longer Mesmerizes. Your personal Brew can be thrown every 20s.
- The Titan will now cleave familiars (EX: Naga Soldiers) and deal double damage vs. familiars
- Gold Fury Gilded Strength buff (on third Gold Fury Kill) now correctly provides 25% increased bonus structure damage. It was dealing 50%.
- This buff no longer affects item procs.
- Decreased Lob Strength Scaling from 65% to 60%.
- Decreased Roll Strength Scaling from 65% to 60%.
- Decreased the slow from 15% per stack to 7.5% per stack.
- Decreased Mystic Surge Duration from 10s to 7s.
- Decreased Bonus Heal Per Tick Base from 11/22/33/44/55 to 8/16/24/32/40.
- Decreased Bonus Heal Per Tick Int Scaling from 4% to 3%.

- Decreased Protection Steal Intelligence Scaling from 1.7% to 1.5%.

- Decreased Base Damage Strength Scaling from 20% to 15%.
- Decreased Base Damage Intelligence Scaling from 40% to 30%.
- Decreased Bonus Damage Strength Scaling from 12.5% to 10%.
- Decreased Bonus Damage Intelligence Scaling from 17.5% to 12.5%.
- Decreased Inner Strength Scaling from 80% to 70% and Outer Strength Scaling from 60% to 50%
- Decreased Amped Damage Scaling from 20% to 15%
- Increased Shield Max Health Scaling from 12.5% to 15%
- Increased Damage Per Tick from 15/20/25/30/35 to 20/25/30/35/40
- Increased Magical Shield Health from 70/140/210/280/350 to 90/155/220/285/350
- Increased Damage from 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% to 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% of enemy’s Current Health
- Increased Bonus damage dealt to Gods from 10% to 12.5% of their Max Health
- Increased low health Bonus Damage from 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% to 15%
- Decreased Scaling from difference in Max HP from 10% to 8%
- Decreased damage dealt to Structures and Bosses from 50% to 25%
- This item now deals the reduced damage to the enemy Titan as well
- Increased Healing obtained from hitting enemy gods from 1% to 2%
- Note - This item had its Max Health increased from 400 to 500
- This buff has already been live
- Stacks are now removed one at a time rather than all together
- Hide of the Nemean Lion Nerf
- The Active reflect is now 50% effective against abilities
- Increased Strength per stack from 10 to 15
- Decreased Threshold to apply a bonus stack from 150 Protections from Items to 120

notes.title: 🎸 The "God of Music Update" is Now Live!
notes.content:
As promised in last Friday’s post, today’s patch has landed. Open Beta 10 is live on PC, bringing a new god and a wave of cosmetics to the game.

[b]Apollo Arrives[/b]

The God of Music is ready to rock. Build Audacity with rapid basics, charm with Serenade, dash in with The Moves, then carry two teammates Across the Sky. His first cosmetic evolution, Aspect of Harmony, releases separately on May 23.

[b]Land Shark Sobek Traveler Page
[/b]
Purchase the Premium Traveler Page to unlock classic Land Shark Sobek instantly and earn three Prism variants (Orca Black, Goldfish Orange, Tubular Teal) plus the “Testing the Waters” jump-stamp and Deepbite badge. 

[b]Mystic Guardian Athena Prisms[/b]

Starflare, Nightshade, Lunarveil and the bundle-exclusive Stardust are now available for Diamonds or in a discounted bundle, turning every shield wall into a light show. 

Jump in, claim your rewards, and check out all the balance changes in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2437170/view/520839674754761837]Open Beta 10 Update Notes[/url]!  

See you on the Battleground!

notes.title: Open Beta 10 The God of Music Arrives May 19th!
notes.content:
The headline for Open Beta 10 is Apollo finally joins SMITE 2! The God of Music unleashes high-speed ranged basics that build Audacity, a crowd-stopping Serenade, the ally-buffing dash The Moves, and his iconic global ultimate Across the Sky, now roomy enough for two teammates. His Aspect, Aspect of Harmony, launches on May 23 bringing a new support focused playstyle that will be music to your ears.

Sobek surfaces with the Land Shark Premium Traveler Page. Buying the page unlocks the classic Land Shark skin immediately, then lets you earn three colour-shifting Prisms (Orca Black, Goldfish Orange, and Tubular Teal) plus the Testing the Waters jump stamp and Deepbite badge for extra bite on the battleground.

Athena fans can polish their shields with Mystic Guardian Prisms. Pick up Starflare, Nightshade, Lunarveil, and the bundle-exclusive Stardust individually for Diamonds or grab all four in a discounted bundle to turn every defense into a light show.

notes.title: Goddess of Destruction Update Launches April 21st
notes.content:
Kali, the Goddess of Destruction, unleashes chaos in SMITE 2, reborn with sharpened blades and an insatiable thirst for vengeance. Stalking the battlefield with her enhanced Marked for Death passive, Kali singles out foes, piercing their defenses and stealing vitality from her marked prey. Leap fearlessly with Nimble Strike, seizing health directly from your foes, or cast Incense to stun enemies, siphoning their life essence and fueling your unstoppable rampage. Her ultimate, Destruction, electrifies the fight, granting invulnerability and relentless damage—ensuring Kali’s foes meet a swift, brutal end.

This update doesn’t stop with Kali’s vengeance—fresh skins and explosive new features ignite SMITE 2! Grab the vibrant Carnival Kiss Pele, harness cosmic energies with Cosmic Conjurer Merlin, or elevate your style with Prism variants like Void Wyrm – Emberglow Gold. Unleash expressive chaos with the hilarious new cosmetic sound emotes called Quips, sending your enemies spiraling into distraction. Strategize like never before with the all-new God Builder, sharing and pinning community-crafted builds for maximum efficiency. Lastly prepare yourself—Firebrands now blaze in the Conquest jungle, granting devastating embers and ramping intensity to new heights.

tags.feature: - Added the Highlights feature.
- A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
- NEW SMITE 2 Skins! (purchasable for 50% Legacy Gems)
- NEW Cosmetic Type: Quips!
- Quips have been added to the game! These are a new sound emote that will use VXQ slots 1, 2, 3 or 4 on PC, the X>LB slot for Xbox, or the Square>R1 slot for PlayStation.
- NEW - God Builder
- You can now save builds for your favorite gods, and share them with the community!
- NEW - Skin Special Emotes aka VXGs
- Special Emote functionality has been added to SMITE 2! Players can use these emotes for Skins that have them by inputting the “Special Emote 2” VGS Command.
- New Feature: Firebrands
- “Firebrands offer a way for junglers, solo laners, and mid laners a way to gain incremental power. They spawn in pairs and will enrage when one of them is slain!”
- Rework: Totem of Ku
- “We’ve disabled the bonus minion effect on the Totem and instead replaced it with a stacking cooldown rate bonus. This reward will be available to grab from the first totem spawn and onwards.”
- Jungle Timers Update
- “SMITE 1 players will recognize how this feature works. For new players joining us in SMITE 2, here’s a breakdown of how the new timers work:”
- Wind Sprite Update

- “Wind Sprites was our first experiment aimed at having objectives spawn new things in the map. We are currently in the iteration phase of pushing this idea further and expanding on its possibilities. In the meantime, we will continue to make adjustments to the Wind Sprites to ensure a fair and balanced map.”
- New Item - Tyrfing
- New Item - Rage
- New Item - Ancient Signet

notes.title: SMITE 2 Artisans Program
notes.content:
Champions of the Battleground,

    We’re thrilled to reveal the SMITE 2 Artisans Program—our brand-new UGC initiative inviting our passionate creators to help shape SMITE 2’s future. This unique opportunity will allow a small number of talented artists to create custom artwork, skins, and other in-game elements that may be featured in SMITE 2, and share in the revenue they earn.

    [b]What Is the Artisans Program?[/b]

    [b]Artistry & Innovation:[/b] The Artisans Program empowers you to bring your unique visions to life in SMITE 2.

    [b]Monetize Your Talent:[/b] By partnering with us, you won't just showcase your creativity—you'll earn directly from it. Approved Artisans will receive a share of revenue, creating a direct connection between your success and the game's thriving community. Our goal is to foster a mutually beneficial partnership, helping you thrive as an artist while enriching the SMITE 2 experience.

    [b]Creative Community: [/b]Join other creatives who share your passion for SMITE 2. Exchange ideas, get feedback, and learn together in a supportive, dedicated environment.

    Phase 1—Limited Early Access Group: Initially, the Artisans Program will launch with Phase 1, a limited-scale pilot designed to set a high-quality benchmark and ensure the program’s long-term success.

    [b]Key details of Phase 1:[/b]
[list]    [*]        Short Application Window: Applications will only be open for a brief period, closing promptly on April 24th at 11:59 PM ET. This initial phase will be highly selective, allowing us to closely collaborate and provide personalized support to each Artisan.    [/*]    [*]        Limited Spots Available: Only a small number of artists will be accepted, offering a focused environment to refine processes and maximize creator success.    [/*]    [*]        Direct Collaboration: Selected Artisans will work closely with the SMITE 2 team to receive direct feedback, extensive support, and in-depth guidance to help elevate their creations.    [/*]    [*]        Early Access Benefits: Participants in this initial group will have a unique opportunity to set trends and standards within the community, potentially securing a lasting impact on SMITE 2’s creative landscape.    [/*][/list]
    [b]How to Apply[/b]

    [url=https://forms.gle/k9p6sSEwanH5nTNv9]Complete the Official Application[/url] -  Be sure to review our [url=https://support.hirezstudios.com/en/articles/11100212-smite-2-artisans-program]terms and conditions[/url], and then you can apply! Be ready to share your portfolio, design experience, and any relevant background.

    [b]Await Selection[/b] - We will notify successful applicants via email and invite them to a program Discord. Only a small number of Artisans will be chosen for this initial phase, but we plan to open the program up wider in the near future.

    [b]Get the Kit and Get Started [/b]-  Once accepted, you’ll gain access to official SMITE 2 assets and guidelines to ensure your work aligns with the game’s style and community expectations.

    Take your creativity to the next level and join the SMITE 2 Artisans!

    —The SMITE 2 Team

We will notify successful applicants via email and invite them to a program Discord.
Only a small number of Artisans will be chosen for this initial phase, but we plan to open the program up wider in the near future.
Once accepted, you’ll gain access to official SMITE 2 assets and guidelines to ensure your work aligns with the game’s style and community expectations.
Take your creativity to the next level and join the SMITE 2 Artisans!

notes.title: Titan Talk and Hotfix Roundup April 10th
notes.content:
[h1]    🔱 SMITE 2: Titan Talk Recap [/h1]
    Welcome to the official recap of the April 10th [u]Titan Talk[/u]! This    week’s episode was hosted by Isiah and Killgoon, covering key updates,    hotfixes, developer insights, and community Q&A. Catch up on everything    you need to know as we march toward OB8 and beyond.
[h2]    ⚙️ Recent Hotfixes Recap[/h2]
    We’ve had [b]three hotfixes since OB7[/b] shipped. Here’s a quick    summary of what’s been resolved:
[h3]    [b]Monday Hotfix[/b][/h3][list]    [*]        
            Fixed shader precaching issue causing load-in freezes.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed Merlin's ability not hitting the totem.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed acquisition screen not closing.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed God stats in the HU Editor.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Resolved the persistent ghost red dot in player profiles.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   [b]Tuesday Hotfix[/b][/h3][list]    [*]        
            Fixed gamepad issue preventing God lock-in on Xbox.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Addressed cursor loss in draft lobbies.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Resolved focus loss and coin purchase bug in Wandering Market.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Adjusted VGS for global emotes.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed acquisition notifications in Wandering Market.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   [b]Wednesday Hotfix[/b][/h3][list]    [*]        
            Fixed Chaac’s ability not hitting stealth targets.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Corrected VO issues with Ra’s Oblivion Tier skin.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Resolved mastery progress showing as incorrect God.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed pricing error for [u]Hydra's Lament[/u].        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Fixed Wandering Market coin progress resetting on login.        
    [/*][/list]
         Hotfixes will continue throughout OB7—keep reporting bugs and sending        feedback!    
[h2]    📅Looking Ahead: OB8 Preview[/h2][list]    [*]        
            [b]Kali Reveal Incoming[/b] – New god Kali drops in OB8!        
    [/*]    [*]        
            [b]Item Specialization Wave 1[/b] – New items + major            balance shifts.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            [b]God Builder Feature (Beta)[/b] – Almost ready! Won’t            include autobuild at launch.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            [b]Possible Movement System Rework[/b] – Flash test is            [b]live now[/b] after the show!        
    [/*][/list][h2]    🎮 Community Questions & Dev Responses[/h2][h3]    🎮 Controller Vibration on Xbox[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Still under investigation—some users report fixes after toggling            vibration settings or unplugging peripherals (like a mouse).        
    [/*]    [*]        
            If you're affected, try toggling vibration OFF then ON again in            settings.        
    [/*][/list][h3]     God Builder Update[/h3][list]    [*]        
            God Builder is nearing completion and may launch in OB8.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Still missing polish and auto-build integration, but usable for            player testing and feedback.        
    [/*][/list][h3]    No Skins Toggle[/h3][list]    [*]        
            A “no skins” mode won’t be added.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Skins are a core monetization element and visual customization is            part of the appeal.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Clarity efforts continue (like God name display in combat and            pre-match screens).        
    [/*][/list][h3]  Wind Sprites Feedback[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Devs heard feedback around Wind Sprites being usable while            crippled—being reviewed.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Wind Sprites will persist longer after use to allow chases.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Sprite quantity on the map may be reduced for balance.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   Prisms and Legacy Gems[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Prisms currently require Diamonds.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            No current plans to support Legacy Gems, but other unlock options            are being explored.        
    [/*][/list][h2]    🎨 Cosmetics, Merch & Monetization[/h2][h3]    🧢 Cosmetics & Kill FX[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Devs are exploring new cosmetics like [b]kill effects[/b]            and potentially [b]HUD skins[/b] down the line.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            HUD skins were expensive in SMITE 1, but tech improvements in SMITE            2 may allow more options.        
    [/*][/list][h3]    👕 Community Merch License[/h3][list]    [*]        
            New licensing program allows players/artists to create and sell            SMITE merchandise using official IP.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Lifetime revenue cap applies before revenue sharing is required.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Launching TODAY after the show!        
    [/*][/list][h2]    📈 Game Design & Balance[/h2][h3]   🛡 Community Meta Sentiment[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Skepticism around OB7 is shifting positively post-launch.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Most players report the patch feels stable and fun.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Item changes and God performance are under continuous review.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   Kali in Playtests[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Kali is [b]very strong[/b] in dev playtests—may receive            nerfs before release.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Strong synergy with new items in OB8 item pass.        
    [/*][/list][h3]    Pele Update Success[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Recent Pele adjustments received great feedback.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Devs aim to implement more targeted God reworks over time using            community feedback.        
    [/*][/list][h2]    📦 Feature Requests & Player Feedback[/h2][h3]    🕹 Ability Ping System[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Devs exploring ability cooldown pinging like ults.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Limited console VGS space complicates full implementation.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   Match Requeue / Runback[/h3][list]    [*]        
            No plans yet but devs like the idea and see value in it for positive            matchups.        
    [/*][/list][h3]   Custom Crosshairs[/h3][list]    [*]        
            More types may be added soon (e.g., dot, reticle, etc.).        
    [/*][/list][h3]   Controller & Xbox Issues[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Xbox crash reports and vibration issues are still being            investigated.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Bug report form and crash logs are critical for fixes—please fill            them out if you're affected.        
    [/*][/list][h2]    Monetization & Referral Systems[/h2][h3]    🛍 Supporter Store + Wandering Market[/h3][list]    [*]        
            OB7 launch and Supporter Store performance has been            [b]                strong            [/b]            .        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Combination of Supporter Store and Wandering Market boosted revenue            significantly.        
    [/*][/list][h3]  Refer-a-Friend Program[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Tech is being built, possibly by RallyHere.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            No concrete system yet, but it’s in active development.        
    [/*][/list][h3]    Free Currency Update[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Wandering Market Coins = main free earnable currency.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            No plans to add a new free currency at this time.        
    [/*][/list][h2]     Movement Rework & Flash Test[/h2]
    A new [b]movement system[/b] is being tested now!
[h3]  Why It Matters:[/h3][list]    [*]        
            Better synchronization between client/server movement.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Reduces “rubber banding” and improves responsiveness—especially on            high ping.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Based on Unreal Engine 5’s [u]Saved Movement[/u] tech.        
    [/*][/list]  
         Try it now via the SMITE 2 Public Test Client on Steam! Feedback and        bug reports welcome in Discord.    
[h2]    🔮 Future Content Teases[/h2][list]    [*]        
            Expect updates on [b]new Gods[/b],            [b]                OB8 balance            [/b]            , and [b]item adjustments[/b] next Monday.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            New [b]movement system flash tests[/b] happening this            week.        
    [/*]    [*]        
            Devs are open to new [u]Titan Talk[/u] formats and guest            appearances—share your ideas!        
    [/*][/list]
    Thanks for reading, and thank you for supporting SMITE 2 as we continue    shaping the battleground of the gods!

    Hey everyone!

    We're kicking off a significant series of adjustments to items in Smite 2. This is a major undertaking, so we'll be rolling out these changes across the next three patches (OB7, OB8, and OB9).
[list]    [*]        OB7 (This Patch): Focuses on resetting the baseline power level of items.    [/*]    [*]        OB8: Will concentrate on enhancing item specialization, making their unique effects more impactful.    [/*]    [*]        OB9 & Hotfixes: Will be dedicated to tying up loose ends and addressing any issues that arise from these broad changes.    [/*][/list]
    Smite 2 initially launched with items being less impactful than they are now. Since then, several factors have increased their overall power: we moved Starter items to a dedicated 7th slot (effectively adding another item's worth of stats/effects), and we've had rapid balance passes that incrementally increased item strength, especially as we figured out the power budget for things like active effects.

    While our starting point for item power in Smite 2 was likely too low, we feel the pendulum has swung too far, and items are currently too strong.

    Let's dive into what we're doing in OB7. Maintaining a specific balance between the inherent power of gods and the power contributed by items is crucial.
[list]    [*]        If gods are too strong relative to items, the strategic flexibility and counter-play potential that items offer gets diminished.    [/*]    [*]        Conversely, if items become too powerful, balancing specific gods or strategies becomes incredibly difficult. For instance, imagine tanks becoming immensely durable due to items. Damage dealers (and even Bruisers) would need proportionally huge damage increases to compensate, leading to scenarios where fragile gods instantly obliterate each other with a single ability.    [/*][/list]
    Finding the right balance here is key. Therefore, in OB7, we're aiming for a broad reduction in overall item power by approximately 10−12%. This adjustment will bring item power down from its current peak but still leave items generally stronger than they were at Smite 2's launch.

    We expect this change to have several positive effects:
[list]    [*]        Alleviate Balance Concerns: It should help address some underlying balance issues stemming from excessive item power.    [/*]    [*]        Breathing Room for Damage Dealers: Pure damage characters should have slightly more survivability in fights against each other without significantly altering the time it takes to defeat tanks.    [/*]    [*]        Objective & Structure Importance: Gods will need to exert more effort and respect the danger when taking objectives or tanking structures, which had become a bit too easy previously.    [/*][/list]
    This baseline reset in OB7 is also essential groundwork for our next phase in OB8: item specialization. By establishing this new power foundation, we can better tune the unique passive and active effects of items, pushing them to be more defining and strategically interesting where appropriate.

tags.feature: Alongside this fierce deity, we’re excited to launch the brand-new SMITE 2 Supporter Store, featuring dazzling Name Flairs and additional Global Emote slots to customize your divine presence like never before.
NEW Cosmetic Type: Name Flairs!
NEW SMITE 2 Supporter Store
Global Emote Slot Bundle - Increases the available number of Global Emote equip slots for use in match from 1 to 4.
NEW Skins and Cosmetics
NEW SMITE 2 Skins! (purchasable for 50% Legacy Gems)
NEW SMITE 2 Event Skins (available FREE via the Easter Event)
Classic Skins (purchasable for 100% Legacy Gems)
Prisms (purchasable for 100% Diamonds)
Cross-Gen Skins (purchasable for 50% Legacy Gems)
Cosmetics
Support Notifications

Players will now receive a pop-up notification upon login if action has been taken against someone they reported for disruptive behavior. Additionally, players who receive multiple reports for disruptive actions will also be notified, providing a clear signal that negative behavior is being monitored and addressed.
Gameplay
NEW Feature - Consumable Dropping
Players can now drop a Consumable Item in their inventory if they pick up a new Item while both consumable slots are full.
Dropped consumables will stay on the ground for 120s and can be picked up by anyone on your allied team by pressing the Interact key.
General
Targeter Updates
HUD Editor
A new slider has been added for minimap “Background Opacity.” This will now allow players to change the opacity of the minimap and the minimap icons independently.
More widgets have been added to the HUD editor
Game Modes
Conquest
New Map Feature - Wind Sprites
When the first Gold Fury is slain, small wind elementals appear around the map
Players can interact with these wind elementals to be propelled forward in the direction they are facing
Assault
(Experimental) Added some Wind Sprite
Duel
God Balance

notes.title: Titan Talk April 3rd Summary: It's too Powerful!
notes.content:
In case you missed it, we covered a lot in yesterday’s Titan Talk—an in-depth discussion where Isiah and Kilgoon walked players through the latest SMITE 2 changes and upcoming plans for the game. Below is a quick yet comprehensive roundup of all the major updates, from big item adjustments in Open Beta 7 to balance tweaks on gods that have been hot topics among the community. Dive in, catch up, and let us know what you think!

[h2]1. General Announcements[/h2][list]  [*]    
[b]Xbox Login Issues[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
The team is aware some players on Xbox may be experiencing login problems.
      [/*]      [*]        
The Titan Forge crew is actively investigating a fix.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Recent Nerf to Yoo's Aspect[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Damage on subsequent bounces was reduced to address overperformance and frustration points.
      [/*]      [*]        
The first hit retains full damage, but follow-up bounces are now reduced.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list][h2]2. Overarching Balance Vision for OB7[/h2][list]  [*]    
[b]A Three-Patch Plan[/b]
    [olist]      [*]        
[b]OB7[/b]: Reset the overall power level of items by roughly 10-12%, setting a more balanced "baseline."
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]OB8[/b]: Sharpen item specialization. Items meant for tank shredding or specific counter-play will have stronger, more specialized identities.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]OB9[/b]: Clean up leftover issues and fine-tune items based on community feedback from the previous two patches.
      [/*]    [/olist]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Why the Across-the-Board Nerfs?[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
SMITE 2's seventh item slot increases total item power compared to SMITE 1.
      [/*]      [*]        
Over time, balance patches led to higher and higher power "creep."
      [/*]      [*]        
Reducing most items by ~10-12% keeps their relative relationships the same (e.g., your favorite item is still your favorite) but lowers the game-wide power curve.
      [/*]      [*]        
Goal: More meaningful counter-play between tanks and carries, slightly lower burst among damage dealers, and a bit more difficulty (and risk) when tackling jungle bosses or diving towers.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list][h2]3. Item Adjustments: Highlights[/h2]
Most items get that 10-12% stat reduction. However, a few see [b]targeted changes[/b] (additional buffs or nerfs) to address larger balance needs.
[h3]Items Kept at Full Strength (i.e., "No Nerf" Is Effectively a Buff)[/h3][list]  [*]    
[b]Titan's Bane & Obsidian Shard[/b]: Premier percent-penetration items for physical and magical damage dealers remain intact.
  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Shifter's Shield[/b]: Underperforming bruiser item; no further nerfs to encourage more usage.
  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Totem of Death[/b]: Intended for specific mage builds and was underused; left intact (or slightly buffed) so it stands out more.
  [/*][/list][h3]Bruiser Items (Extra Changes)[/h3][list]  [*]    
[b]Gladiator Shield[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Loses physical protection, making it less effective if rushed too early.
      [/*]      [*]        
Passive damage slightly [b]stronger[/b] if you fully commit to tank items in the rest of your build.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Glorious Pridwen[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Reduced protections and cooldown reduction.
      [/*]      [*]        
Slightly stronger shield explosion if you have multiple tank items.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Mystical Mail[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Reduced health and physical protection.
      [/*]      [*]        
Passive remains the same (it still punishes enemies near you in-lane), but it's no longer your all-in-one best defensive rush item.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Runeforged Hammer[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Increased cost, decreased strength, health, and health regen.
      [/*]      [*]        
Still grants big payoff on hard crowd-control hits, but less lane sustain out of the gate.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Shield of the Phoenix[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Lower defenses overall, but synergy with high-health builds is enhanced.
      [/*]      [*]        
Retains strong scaling when you stack more HP items.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Void Stone[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Health lowered significantly to line up better with its physical counterpart, Void Shield.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list][h3]Carry Items (Extra Changes)[/h3][list]  [*]    
[b]Qin's Blade & Sunbeam Bow[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Additional nerfs beyond the 10-12% baseline to curb how early these high-DPS items come online.
      [/*]      [*]        
These should feel better later in the game, especially if you combine them with other on-hit or offensive items.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list][h2]4. Relic Changes: Blink[/h2][list]  [*]    
[b]Blink's Cooldown[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Lowered from 210 seconds to 180 seconds.
      [/*]      [*]        
Further 30-second reduction if you successfully damage a god or secure a kill within four seconds of blinking.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Goal[/b]: Encourage using Blink aggressively rather than purely to flee. Overall feel is that the healthier, out-of-combat restrictions remain, but it's now more rewarding to initiate fights.
  [/*][/list][h2]5. God Balance Highlights[/h2]
Below are standout god adjustments. (Many receive the standard 10-12% item power shift, but these are direct kit changes.)
[list]  [*]    
[b]Merlin[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Buffs to several stances (Arcane 1 & 2, Fire 1) for underperformance.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Blizzard[/b] range corrected to match intended design.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Aladdin (Major Shift)[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Base versions of abilities deal more reliable damage for poke/clear.
      [/*]      [*]        
Genie forms (ultimate-enhanced versions) have reduced top-end burst.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Lamp (Ultimate)[/b]: Deals damage on throw (cannot kill from full if you raise the enemy's health), but no longer puts enemies at a larger health disadvantage when entering the lamp realm.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Hecate[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Several damage buffs (Triplicate Form, Radiate, Open the Gates).
      [/*]      [*]        
Boosts overall damage consistency without overdoing her wave-clear abilities.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Bacchus[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
[b]Chug[/b]: Lower cooldown, enhanced protections.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Belly Flop[/b]: Increased damage and slow duration matches official knock-up timing.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Vulcan[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Various passive mod tweaks to strengthen underused mod choices.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Backfire[/b]: Minor damage increase for better poke.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Cabrakan[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Tank builds improved: Gains additional mitigation scaling based on item protections.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Refraction Shield (Enhanced)[/b]: Slight health restore scales with maximum HP.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Rom[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
More damage on [b]Rolling Assault[/b] bonus attack and [b]Astral Barrage[/b].
      [/*]      [*]        
Aiming to raise his performance in laning and late-game.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Pele (Shift)[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Dash mechanic on [b]Eruption[/b] (when Magma Rush is active) removed.
      [/*]      [*]        
Eruption now [b]always[/b] grants a big burst of movement speed during its pre-fire, letting you juke or reposition more smoothly.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Morrigan[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Dot damage from passive is now "ability damage" (no longer triggers minion executes).
      [/*]      [*]        
Some wave-clear toned down, but [b]Deadly Aspects[/b] and [b]Dark Omen[/b] scaling increased to compensate in direct fights.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Princess Bari[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Overall nerfs: Decreased attack speed from Mystic Surge, lowered damage/scaling on Reverent Steps.
      [/*]      [*]        
Fixed a bug causing [b]Sacred Bell[/b] to over-benefit from Intelligence.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Awilix[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
Reverted to previous nerfs: Lower scaling on Suku and Moonlight Charge, after bug fixes didn't reduce her performance as much as expected.
      [/*]    [/list]  [/*]  [*]    
[b]Mordrid[/b]
    [list]      [*]        
[b]Aspect of Rage[/b]: Lower CDR gained while Blood Rage is active.
      [/*]      [*]        
[b]Cruel Strikes[/b]: Increased cooldown.

tags.balance_change: Damage on subsequent bounces was reduced to address overperformance and frustration points.
The first hit retains full damage, but follow-up bounces are now reduced.
OB7: Reset the overall power level of items by roughly 10-12%, setting a more balanced "baseline."
OB8: Sharpen item specialization. Items meant for tank shredding or specific counter-play will have stronger, more specialized identities.
OB9: Clean up leftover issues and fine-tune items based on community feedback from the previous two patches.
Reducing most items by ~10-12% keeps their relative relationships the same (e.g., your favorite item is still your favorite) but lowers the game-wide power curve.
Goal: More meaningful counter-play between tanks and carries, slightly lower burst among damage dealers, and a bit more difficulty (and risk) when tackling jungle bosses or diving towers.
Loses physical protection, making it less effective if rushed too early.
Passive damage slightly [b]stronger[/b] if you fully commit to tank items in the rest of your build.
Slightly stronger shield explosion if you have multiple tank items.
Increased cost, decreased strength, health, and health regen.
Still grants big payoff on hard crowd-control hits, but less lane sustain out of the gate.
Lower defenses overall, but synergy with high-health builds is enhanced.
Retains strong scaling when you stack more HP items.
Health lowered significantly to line up better with its physical counterpart, Void Shield.
Additional nerfs beyond the 10-12% baseline to curb how early these high-DPS items come online.
These should feel better later in the game, especially if you combine them with other on-hit or offensive items.
Further 30-second reduction if you successfully damage a god or secure a kill within four seconds of blinking.
Goal: Encourage using Blink aggressively rather than purely to flee. Overall feel is that the healthier, out-of-combat restrictions remain, but it's now more rewarding to initiate fights.
Buffs to several stances (Arcane 1 & 2, Fire 1) for underperformance.
Blizzard range corrected to match intended design.
Base versions of abilities deal more reliable damage for poke/clear.
Genie forms (ultimate-enhanced versions) have reduced top-end burst.
Lamp (Ultimate): Deals damage on throw (cannot kill from full if you raise the enemy's health), but no longer puts enemies at a larger health disadvantage when entering the lamp realm.
Several damage buffs (Triplicate Form, Radiate, Open the Gates).
Boosts overall damage consistency without overdoing her wave-clear abilities.
Belly Flop: Increased damage and slow duration matches official knock-up timing.
Various passive mod tweaks to strengthen underused mod choices.
Backfire: Minor damage increase for better poke.
Tank builds improved: Gains additional mitigation scaling based on item protections.
Refraction Shield (Enhanced): Slight health restore scales with maximum HP.
More damage on Rolling Assault bonus attack and Astral Barrage.
Aiming to raise his performance in laning and late-game.
Dash mechanic on Eruption (when Magma Rush is active) removed.
Eruption now always grants a big burst of movement speed during its pre-fire, letting you juke or reposition more smoothly.
Dot damage from passive is now "ability damage" (no longer triggers minion executes).
Some wave-clear toned down, but Deadly Aspects and Dark Omen scaling increased to compensate in direct fights.
Overall nerfs: Decreased attack speed from Mystic Surge, lowered damage/scaling on Reverent Steps.

notes.title: Safeguarding SMITE 2
notes.content:
Hey deities! We’ve read a lot of feedback recently and saw a big frustration some of you face on the battleground is dealing with players who go AFK (Away from Keyboard) or intentionally feed. These actions can seriously derail a fair, exciting match—so we want you to know that we hear your concerns and we’re doing everything in our power to address them. SMITE 2 is all about bringing people together for intense, strategic gameplay, and we’re dedicated to doing everything we can to eliminate behaviors that undermine the experience for everyone.

    While we use a variety of tools to track and reduce toxic activities, we’re especially proud of the work we’ve done with our partners at[url=https://getgud.io/] GetGud.io[/url] to tackle disruptive behavior head-on. Through close monitoring, pattern recognition, and community input, we’re striving to keep SMITE 2 a positive, competitive space where players can have fun and test their skills.

    [b]The Impact of AFK and Intentional Feeding[/b]

    When someone leaves a game or deliberately allows the enemy to rack up kills, it doesn’t just hurt that person’s team—it diminishes the entire match for everyone involved. We realize just how frustrating it can be when you’re left shorthanded or when the opposition is getting a free pass.We all want fair matches, so it’s crucial that we stop these behaviors before they become a pattern. We want every player to feel they’re part of a team effort, with a real chance to show off their skills and contribute to a memorable match.

    [h2]How SMITE 2 is Evolving[/h2]

    [b]Data-Driven Detection with GetGud.io[/b]

    To tackle disruptive behavior effectively, we’re leveraging [b]GetGud.io[/b]—a powerful data-analysis platform. Based on publicly shared details, GetGud.io takes a deep dive into match data, looking at things like:
[list]    [*]        [b]Match Duration and Player Activity:[/b] Pinpointing unusual patterns of inactivity, such as frequent fountain stays or abrupt disconnects.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Kill/Death/Assist Ratios and Gold Trends:[/b] Spotting anomalies that indicate someone might be feeding the enemy.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Behavior Over Time:[/b] Checking for repeated negative trends versus one-off incidents that might be caused by technical hiccups.    [/*][/list]
    Once potential AFK or feeding behavior is flagged, our enforcement team reviews it and takes action. Our goal is to keep innocent players safe while ensuring that those who consistently disrupt the game face the appropriate consequences.

    [img]https://webcdn.hirezstudios.com/smite2-cdn/GG_1_e6c88ed657.jpg[/img]

    This example below, GetGud allows us to observe this player sitting in the fountain for a significant portion of the match. 

    [img]https://webcdn.hirezstudios.com/smite2-cdn/GG_2_e0e64244b3.jpg[/img]

    [b]Player Reporting and Feedback[/b]

    Of course, even the smartest systems can’t replace your own real-time insights. We rely on your reports to help us identify when and where things are going wrong:
[list]    [*]        [b]Streamlined Reporting Interface:[/b] At the end of a match, it’s quick and easy to report a player for AFK, intentional feeding, or other bad behavior.    [/*]    [*]        [b]Clear Follow-Up:[/b] With Open Beta 7 we are introducting a new pop up that will inform you if a player you've reported has had action taken on their account.     [/*][/list]
    [img]https://webcdn.hirezstudios.com/smite2-cdn/action_taken_7e6099e5c2.png[/img]

    [b]Building a More Positive Community[/b]

    Our fight against negativity doesn’t end at punishments. We want SMITE 2 to be an inviting space where players connect, communicate well, and celebrate each other’s successes. Part of this includes:
[list][*] We encourage you to give props to teammates and opponents who show sportsmanship, teamwork, and stellar performance. Call out solid plays when you see them![/*]
[*]Help players who are new to SMITE 2 succeed. Not everyone is a SMITE 1 veteran and sometimes a little [/list]

[b]The Road Ahead[/b]

We’re fully aware that AFK and intentional feeding can be a persistent issue in any competitive online game, however through these efforts, we believe we’re headed in the right direction toward a more enjoyable and balanced SMITE 2 experience for everyone.

We encourage you to keep reporting negative behavior, lend a hand to new players, and maintain a positive mindset in every match. 

[b]Thank you for being part of the SMITE 2 community.[/b] We appreciate your commitment to fair, competitive matches, and we’ll continue to work hard to protect that spirit. Your feedback drives us to constantly refine and improve, and we’re excited about the brighter, fairer future we’re building together.

tags.balance_change: - With updated movement mechanics, conquest camps, and item tweaks, there’s never been a better time to jump in.

notes.title: Open Beta 6 - Merlin and More Arrives Monday!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to SMITE 2’s OB6 Update![/b] Prepare yourselves for        a truly magical patch as the legendary wizard [b]Merlin[/b]        joins the battleground of the gods. Equipped with three potent        stances—Arcane, Fire, and Ice—Merlin unleashes an arsenal of versatile        abilities. From conjuring celestial orbs in [b]Eclipse[/b] to        channeling scorching beams in [b]Radiate[/b] and freezing foes        with [b]Frostbolt[/b], Merlin epitomizes high-octane        spell-slinging at its finest. His [b]Elemental Mastery[/b]        Ultimate even switches stances on the fly, keeping enemies guessing as        they struggle to keep up with his rapid-fire combos and shapeshifting        bursts of power.    
    
        But Merlin is only the beginning! [b]OB6[/b] introduces the        brand-new [b]Aspect of Pandemonium[/b] for those who crave        unpredictability, a groundbreaking [b]Prisms[/b] system that        unlocks alternate color schemes and VFX for select skins, and a slew of        new and returning cosmetics—from the flashy        [b]            Stumble Blade Susano        [/b]        to classic fan-favorites. On the gameplay front, expect improved        movement mechanics, updated conquest camps, and item changes that tweak        both new and familiar builds. Whether you’re looking to master the        arcane arts with Merlin, experiment with fresh jungle starts, or        showcase your style with vibrant Prisms, OB6 has something to captivate        every SMITE 2 player.    
    
        See below for the full patch notes and dive into the details of each new        feature, balance adjustment, and cosmetic release. The battleground is        evolving—don’t miss your chance to harness Merlin’s magic and take        charge of the new era in SMITE 2!

tags.balance_change: * Eul's Scepter of Divinity: Bonus movement speed reduced from +40 to +30
- Reduced Bonus damage reduction given to minions from 25% to 10%
- Reduced Bonus physical power given to minions from 20 to 10
- Deals 250 base damage + 25 per minute that has passed (not including the setup time)
- Reduced First blood gold reward from 200 to 75
- Ares gains 10/15/20/25/30 HPS while the buff is active on himself. This does not apply to his Aspect Call to Arms.
- Initial Damage now has 20% Intelligence Scaling
- Pull Damage now has 50% Intelligence Scaling
- Increased Missing Health Heal from 2.5% to 5%.
- Decreased Movement Speed while carrying a target from 75% to 40%.
- Removed the protection shred from the buildup.
- Now applies the full strength of the Protection Shred on hit. Its own damage will benefit from this Protection Shred.
- Targets will now be immune to the fear after 3 ticks, making the Maximum duration you can be feared 1s.
- Increased Strength Scaling from 10% per tick to 12.5% per tick
- Again applies a Knockup to enemies who walk into it after the initial burst, at 60% of the initial burst.
- Again applies Damage to enemies who walk into it after the initial burst, at 60% of the initial burst.
- Protections gained from the Grabbing a god persist for 3s after the dash ends. This does not apply to the Aspect grab.
- Increased Pulse Intelligence Scaling from 50% to 60%.
- Increased Projectile Strength Scaling from 60% to 75%.
- Arrows fired now have 10% Strength Scaling.
- Reduced stacks on targets from 6 to 3.
- Debuff Duration is increased from 4s to 5s.
- Increased uncharged damage from 50% Max to 80% Max.
- Mending Waters no longer affects allies but stops and bounces on enemy gods, dealing damage, shield damage and providing Yemoja 6/7/8/9/10 Int per hit, stacking up to 6 times, for 10s.
- Additionally Moonstrike no longer stuns gods but its scaling has increased from 40% to 75%

- Passive: After applying a Hard Crowd Control to an enemy god, mark them with a rune for 5s. Basic Attack them to forge that rune dealing 50 + 50% of your Item Protections as Magical Damage. This can only occur once every 40s. Hard Crowd Control applied to enemy gods while on cooldown reduces the cooldown by 3s.
- Passive: You take 10% reduced Basic Attack damage. Taking Basic Attack damage reduces this item's cooldown by 2s.
- Active: Your next ability that damages an enemy god will silence them for 1.5s. Cooldown: 80s.
- Passive: Damaging an enemy with an ability heals 3 Health and 4 Mana, once per target per ability. Heal an additional 3 Health and 4 Mana if this was a god. Requires level 20 to upgrade

- Passive: Damaging an enemy with an ability heals 1% Health and Mana, once per target per ability. Heal an additional 1% Health and Mana if this was a god. For every Kill you have this game, increase the Heal by 0.1%.
- No longer provides a buff and heal upon defeating Jungle Camps, Structures, and Jungle Bosses die.
- Now provides “Basic Attacks deal 15% bonus Physical Damage to all enemies within 1.92m of the target.”
- Decreased max stack count from 5 to 4.
- Increased Physical Protection per stack from 5 to 7.
- Increased Protections bonus from max stacks from 10 to 15.
- Increased Item Protections scaling from 10% to 15%.
- God Per Level Damage increased from 4 to 6.
- Cooldown Reduced by 30s if used only on Jungle Monsters/Bosses.
- Decreased Reveal debuff and Movement Speed buff durations from 10s to 6s.

notes.title: Titan Talk! Blink Testing, Susano Prism and More!
notes.content:
If you missed Titan Talk today, there was a ton of stuff covered including a Blink combat test and a look at the upcoming Susano Prism! We've summarized everything for you below!

[previewyoutube=8OOGPrmDOko;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]1. Flash Tests (PTS) for OB6[/h2][list]    [*]        
[b]Two Rounds of Flash Testing[/b]
        [list]            [*][b]Round 1[/b]: Happened yesterday, provided initial feedback on OB6.[/*]            [*][b]Round 2[/b]: Taking place [b]today, 2 PM – 4 PM ET[/b]on the PTS.[list]                    [*][b]Conquest Queue[/b] will be live during those two hours.[/*]                    [*]Additional [b]skins[/b] should be enabled, including previews of new OB6 cosmetics.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]        
[b]Overnight Server Availability[/b]
        [list]            [*]After 4 PM ET, the Conquest Queue ends, but [b]custom matches and jungle practice[/b] remain available [b]all night[/b].[/*]            [*]This extended uptime helps players who can’t join the short test window (e. g. due to work or school).[/*]            [*]Feedback is welcomed via [b]Discord forums[/b] (look for the dedicated bug-reporting and feedback channels).[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]2. Yemoja Aspect Changes[/h2][list]    [*][b]Improved Bounce Mechanics[/b]        [list]            [*]Emjoji’s “bubble” (her 2) now [b]bounces to enemies[/b] for damage.[/*]            [*]If there’s no additional target to bounce to, it will [b]bounce back[/b] to the original enemy at least once, guaranteeing [b]two damage instances[/b] even in a 1v1 scenario.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Continued Adjustments[/b]        [list]            [*]There is still ongoing discussion about whether spending 3 Omi on this ability is worthwhile.[/*]            [*]The team wants to ensure it feels fun and strong; your feedback during the flash test is critical.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]3. Live “Combat Blink” Test (A.K.A. the “Blink Test”)[/h2][list]    [*][b]Temporary Disabling of Combat Blink[/b]        [list]            [*]Combat Blink is being [b]turned off in live matches[/b] for a few days to gather data.[/*]            [*]The goal is to see how removing this relic [b]affects pacing[/b], [b]engages[/b], and [b]team fights[/b].[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Community Feedback & Survey[/b]        [list]            [*]A formal [b]survey[/b] will be released later this week—after players have time to feel the difference in real matches.[/*]            [*]Devs are exploring if combat blink should return in its current form, revert to the [u]Smite 1[/u] style, become a hybrid relic, or something entirely new.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]4. Matchmaking Improvements[/h2][list]    [*][b]Significant Improvements Noted[/b]        [list]            [*]Recent background adjustments aim to provide [b]more balanced teams[/b] in both casual and ranked modes.[/*]            [*]One standout statistic:[list]                    [*]On March 12, only [b]40%[/b] of ranked matches were within a 100 SR difference per team.[/*]                    [*]By March 18, that rose to [b]80%[/b] of matches meeting that standard.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Continued Tuning[/b]        [list]            [*]More changes are being tested and refined.[/*]            [*]Expect additional data insights (with handy graphs!) in upcoming dev communications.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]5. Movement Overhaul & Upcoming Tests[/h2][list]    [*][b]Core Movement Code Rework[/b]        [list]            [*]The team is actively [b]rebuilding core movement systems[/b] to feel snappier and more responsive.[/*]            [*]Internal playtests show this new approach feels “tremendously better” about [b]90%[/b] of the time.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Potential Flash Test Soon[/b]        [list]            [*]These changes will likely be tested on a separate branch of the game (meaning not on the main PTS right away) to avoid breaking other areas.[/*]            [*]Exact timing is TBD, but players can expect an upcoming [b]focus test[/b] to gather real-world feedback.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]6. New Susano Skin: “Stumble Blade”[/h2][list]    [*][b]Cartoon-Themed Aesthetics[/b]        [list]            [*]Susano’s new skin has a [b]fun, toon-inspired[/b] style, especially noticeable in his wind-based abilities.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Prism Color Variations[/b]        [list]            [*]Multiple “Prism” color swaps (e.g., [b]Amethyst[/b], [b]Crimson[/b], [b]Copper[/b]) let you change the ability FX color scheme on the same skin.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]In-Game Preview During Flash Test[/b]        [list]            [*]Susano’s new skin (and other OB6 skins) should be available in the [b]PTS[/b] so you can see it before it goes live.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]7. Full Patch Notes & Merlin’s Release[/h2][list]    [*][b]Patch Notes on Friday[/b]        [list]            [*]Tune into [u]Titan Talk[/u] (Friday) for the [b]full patch notes[/b] breakdown.[/*]            [*]Pond will be detailing [b]balance changes[/b] and other updates.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]OB6 Goes Live on Monday[/b]        [list]            [*]The new update (including [b]Merlin[/b] as the latest god) arrives to live servers on Monday.[/*]            [*]Expect additional content and features highlighted in Friday’s patch notes reveal.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2]8. Additional Community Q&A Highlights[/h2][list]    [*][b]Next Gods & Future Releases[/b]        [list]            [*]Following Merlin, upcoming gods include [b]Cerberus, Guan Yu, Kali, Aphrodite,[/b] and [b]Apollo[/b].[/*]            [*]King Arthur remains on the radar, but his unique technical challenges are slowing the process.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Movement & Mobility Discussions[/b]        [list]            [*]Ongoing conversation about [b]CC buffering[/b] and leaps, plus balancing the abundant mobility in SMITE 2.[/*]            [*]Disabling Combat Blink is one of many steps to test how movement/fight flow changes when certain tools are removed or retooled.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Focus on Feature Completeness[/b]        [list]            [*]The dev team continues balancing how quickly they release new gods versus implementing core features (e.g., better matchmaking, improved HUD/editor, new systems like “Prisms,” etc.).[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Community Merch License[/b]        [list]            [*]Soon, there will be a [b]community licensing option[/b] allowing fans to create and sell limited-run SMITE 2 merchandise without legal complications, as long as it meets certain guidelines and earning thresholds.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]How to Provide Feedback[/h3][olist]    [*][b]Play in the PTS[/b] (2 PM – 4 PM ET Conquest queues, or custom matches overnight).[/*]    [*][b]Try Live Matches Without Combat Blink[/b] and share how it feels.[/*]    [*][b]Join Official Discord[/b]: Use the dedicated feedback and bug-report channels.[/*]    [*][b]Keep an Eye on Socials & Reddit[/b]: Surveys will be posted to gather large-scale input on the Blink changes.[/*][/olist]

notes.title: OB6 is Looking Magical!
notes.content:
If you missed the magic in today's Titan Talk, we've got a wrap-up for you! Merlin, Yemoja Aspect, and a ton more below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832142/1b8ec4be75f1826192047176af3b62e7b74b8cc8.png[/img]

[h2]Merlin Arrives in OB6[/h2][h3]Overview[/h3][list]    [*][b]Long-Awaited Mage[/b]: Merlin is one of the most requested mages yet to appear in Smite 2, now joining the roster in OB6.[/*]    [*][b]Core Kit[/b]: Retains his triple-stance playstyle (Arcane, Fire, Ice) from Smite 1, with slight “plus-one” twists in Smite 2.[/*][/list][h3]Notable Changes & “Plus Ones”[/h3][list]    [*]        
[b]Enhanced Flicker[/b]
        [list]            [*][b]Arcane Flicker[/b]: Heals Merlin based on recent damage taken.[/*]            [*][b]Fire Flicker[/b]: Briefly applies a Radiate DoT (damage-over-time) to enemies.[/*]            [*][b]Ice Flicker[/b]: Reduces Merlin’s ability cooldowns by 5 seconds.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]        
[b]Fire Stance Radiate[/b]
        [list]            [*]Radiate (1) now applies a burn DoT that also spreads via Merlin’s other fire abilities (the Dragonfire center, ultimate transitions, etc.).[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Merlin’s Ascension Pass[/h3][list]    [*][b]Colorful Progression[/b]: Unlock multiple recolors (Shadow, Onyx, Opal, Radiant) as you level up Merlin.[/*]    [*][b]New Emotes & Trackers[/b]: Includes a “Ponder the Elements” global emote, mastery emote, kill trackers, and more.[/*][/list][h3]Merlin’s Aspect: Pandemonium][/h3][list]    [*][b]Randomized Stance Swap[/b]: Each time Merlin uses his ultimate (Elemental Mastery), it randomly selects a stance and two “primary” abilities (1 and 2).[/*]    [*][b]Shorter Ultimate Cooldown[/b]: Enables faster stance-cycling and more frequent casting—but at the cost of randomness.[/*]    [*][b]Intelligence Buff[/b]: Each stance swap grants temporary INT, boosting Merlin’s power.[/*]    [*][b]Release Timing[/b]: This Aspect will drop a short while after OB6 goes live (not on Day 1).[/*][/list][h2]Yemoja’s New Aspect: Downpour[/h2][list]    [*][b]Offensive Twist[/b]: Shifts Yemoja’s healing-based kit into a damage focus.[/*]    [*][b]Mending Waters (2)[/b]: No longer heals allies. Instead, it bounces among enemy gods, dealing damage and building Yemoja’s INT (power) stacks.[/*]    [*][b]Moonstrike (B01)[/b]: Gains higher scaling for more damage but loses its stun on enemy gods (it still stuns towers).[/*]    [*][b]Availability[/b]: Scheduled to appear about a week after OB6 launches.[/*][/list][h2]Skin Highlights[/h2][h3]Classic Skins Returning[/h3][olist]    [*][b]Bass Cannon Neith[/b] (EDM-style skin)[/*]    [*][b]Heavens Rave Zeus[/b] (another EDM/music theme)[/*]    [*][b]High Honor Mulan[/b] (inspired by the Immortal skin style)[/*]    [*][b]Dawn Spirit Yemoja[/b] (a popular, ethereal-looking Yemoja skin)[/*][/olist][h3]All-New Toon Tech: StumbleBlade Susano[/h3][list]    [*][b]Cel-Shaded Look[/b]: Built using fresh Unreal Engine 5 tech for a true “toon” effect.[/*]    [*][b]Colorful, Bold Visuals[/b]: Stands apart from the rest of the map in a fun, animated style.[/*][/list][h3]Introducing “Prisms”[/h3][list]    [*][b]Extra Recolors[/b]: Special alternate color variants for selected skins (starting with StumbleBlade Susano).[/*]    [*][b]Custom-Tailored Effects[/b]: These recolors also change the skill VFX.[/*]    [*][b]Supporter Premiere[/b]: Prisms cost diamonds with no legacy-gem discounts. The base Susano skin still supports legacy gems at 50%.[/*][/list][h2]New Items Arriving in OB6[/h2][olist]    [*]        
[b]Vampiric Shroud[/b]
        [list]            [*][b]Starter for Bruiser Mages[/b]: Provides health, intelligence, and sustain.[/*]            [*][b]Bloodsoaked Shroud Upgrade[/b]: Increases healing and adds %healing on damage.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]        
[b]Runeforge Hammer[/b]
        [list]            [*][b]Strength + Max Health[/b]: Ideal hybrid item for bruisers or guardians.[/*]            [*][b]Polynomicon-Style Passive[/b]: Hard-CC an enemy to mark them, then your next basic attack deals extra magical damage based on your protections.[/*]            [*][b]Reduced Cooldown via CC[/b]: More crowd-control = faster rune resets.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]        
[b]Enchile[/b]
        [list]            [*][b]Anti-Magic Bruiser Item[/b]: Grants magic protection, max health, and reduced damage from basic attacks.[/*]            [*][b]Silence Effect[/b]: Taking hits builds up a charge; activate to make your next ability silence enemies for 1.5s.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/olist][h2]Conquest Map Art Updates[/h2][list]    [*][b]Buff Camp Landmarks[/b]: Three buff areas receive major visual overhauls for clarity and theme:[list]            [*][b]Blue Buff[/b]: Frog-like idols and watery details.[/*]            [*][b]Red Buff[/b]: Sharp spikes, skulls, and sinister structures.[/*]            [*][b]Purple Buff[/b]: Arcane trees and eerie purplish lighting.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Better Navigation[/b]: Each buff camp is instantly recognizable by color and shape.[/*][/list][h2]Ongoing Work & Future Plans[/h2][list]    [*][b]Movement & Netcode Overhaul[/b]: Dev team is actively refining the underlying movement code to address jittery body-blocks, odd pulls (e.g., Khepri’s), and overall pacing.[/*]    [*][b]Combat Blink Discussion[/b]: Evaluating the impact and whether it encourages too much unpredictability or easy escapes.[/*]    [*][b]Early-Game Snowball[/b]: Looking into ways to reduce extreme early leads in Conquest without heavy-handed comeback mechanics.[/*]    [*][b]Godbuilder System[/b]: In development to let players share and browse community-made builds and item tips in-game.[/*][/list][h2]Q&A Highlights[/h2][list]    [*][b]“Had Fun?” Button[/b]: The thumbs-up/down at match end is used internally to gauge overall match enjoyment.[/*]    [*][b]Auto-Build vs. Advanced Builds[/b]: Auto-build remains a “no-thought” option, while the future Godbuilder aims to help intermediate players learn more advanced item choices.[/*]    [*][b]Legacy “Divine” Skins[/b]: Currently remain rewards for Smite 1 veterans, but the team may revisit how to offer them in the future.[/*][/list][h2]Wrap-Up[/h2]
OB6 is packed with exciting changes: Merlin’s grand debut, new Aspects for Merlin and Yemoja, vibrant skins (including toon-tech Susano), fresh items, and improved buff-camp visuals. Keep an eye out for the first OB6 Flash Test announcements to jump in early and try it all.

tags.feature: - Merlin is one of the most requested mages yet to appear in Smite 2, now joining the roster in OB6.
- Arcane Flicker: Heals Merlin based on recent damage taken.
- Fire Flicker: Briefly applies a Radiate DoT (damage-over-time) to enemies.
- Ice Flicker: Reduces Merlin’s ability cooldowns by 5 seconds.
- Radiate (1) now applies a burn DoT that also spreads via Merlin’s other fire abilities (the Dragonfire center, ultimate transitions, etc.).
- Unlock multiple recolors (Shadow, Onyx, Opal, Radiant) as you level up Merlin.
- Includes a “Ponder the Elements” global emote, mastery emote, kill trackers, and more.
- Randomized Stance Swap: Each time Merlin uses his ultimate (Elemental Mastery), it randomly selects a stance and two “primary” abilities (1 and 2).
- Enables faster stance-cycling and more frequent casting—but at the cost of randomness.
- Each stance swap grants temporary INT, boosting Merlin’s power.
- This Aspect will drop a short while after OB6 goes live (not on Day 1).
- Shifts Yemoja’s healing-based kit into a damage focus.
- Mending Waters (2): No longer heals allies. Instead, it bounces among enemy gods, dealing damage and building Yemoja’s INT (power) stacks.
- Moonstrike (B01): Gains higher scaling for more damage but loses its stun on enemy gods (it still stuns towers).
- Availability: Scheduled to appear about a week after OB6 launches.
- Bass Cannon Neith (EDM-style skin)
- Heavens Rave Zeus (another EDM/music theme)
- High Honor Mulan (inspired by the Immortal skin style)
- Dawn Spirit Yemoja (a popular, ethereal-looking Yemoja skin)
- Built using fresh Unreal Engine 5 tech for a true “toon” effect.
- Stands apart from the rest of the map in a fun, animated style.
- Special alternate color variants for selected skins (starting with StumbleBlade Susano).
- These recolors also change the skill VFX.
- Prisms cost diamonds with no legacy-gem discounts. The base Susano skin still supports legacy gems at 50%.
- Starter for Bruiser Mages: Provides health, intelligence, and sustain.
- Bloodsoaked Shroud Upgrade: Increases healing and adds %healing on damage.
- Strength + Max Health: Ideal hybrid item for bruisers or guardians.
- Polynomicon-Style Passive: Hard-CC an enemy to mark them, then your next basic attack deals extra magical damage based on your protections.
- More crowd-control = faster rune resets.
- Anti-Magic Bruiser Item: Grants magic protection, max health, and reduced damage from basic attacks.
- Taking hits builds up a charge; activate to make your next ability silence enemies for 1.5s.
- Blue Buff: Frog-like idols and watery details.
- Red Buff: Sharp spikes, skulls, and sinister structures.
- Purple Buff: Arcane trees and eerie purplish lighting.
- Each buff camp is instantly recognizable by color and shape.
- Dev team is actively refining the underlying movement code to address jittery body-blocks, odd pulls (e.g., Khepri’s), and overall pacing.
- Evaluating the impact and whether it encourages too much unpredictability or easy escapes.
- Looking into ways to reduce extreme early leads in Conquest without heavy-handed comeback mechanics.
- In development to let players share and browse community-made builds and item tips in-game.
- The thumbs-up/down at match end is used internally to gauge overall match enjoyment.
- Auto-build remains a “no-thought” option, while the future Godbuilder aims to help intermediate players learn more advanced item choices.
- Currently remain rewards for Smite 1 veterans, but the team may revisit how to offer them in the future.
